title: Pittman/Eches will forever be my bestie. #titanicthemusical
transcript: Har du fått deg kjøttdeig and ready for sea, captain. Lower the gangway, Mr. Bitman. Gangways all. Lower, sir. Make fast the top topsails, all tops! Let go of all life. Let go of the star lines. Let go of the bow lines. Let go of offspring
